request.lyrics:
[Verse]
After Tola rose Jair the Gileadite
He judged Israel for twenty-two years
His thirty sons rode on thirty donkeys
In the land of Gilead they were there

[Verse]
They had thirty towns in that region
Called Havvoth Jair to this day
The Gileadite led the people
With strength and purpose in his way

[Verse]
His sons rode their donkey colts
Across the hills of Gilead
The towns bore his name forever
A legacy in the wild and the shade

[Verse]
Then Jair died his time had come
Buried in Kamon at last
He judged Israel with faithfulness
A judge in the ancient past

[Outro]
Havvoth Jair remains to this day
